tools.name: fs_stat
tools.description: Report file bytes, text/binary/unknown classification and exact text line count.

tools.name: fs_chmod
tools.description: Set exact POSIX permissions on one workspace file or directory.

tools.name: fs_list
tools.description: List directory entries with bounded depth, filters and pagination.

tools.name: fs_glob
tools.description: Search relative paths using a POSIX glob and shared metadata filters.

tools.name: fs_find
tools.description: Find objects recursively by metadata and optional full-text content filter.

tools.description: Read a line slice with explicit encoding or heuristic detection.

tools.description: Read JSON, YAML or TOML into a JSON-compatible data structure.

tools.name: fs_read_markdown
tools.description: Parse CommonMark plus tables and strikethrough into a nested token AST.

tools.name: fs_write
tools.description: Create or explicitly replace a text file.

tools.name: fs_write_jyt
tools.description: Serialize a JSON-compatible structure as JSON, YAML or TOML.

tools.name: fs_copy
tools.description: Copy a file, directory tree to an exact destination.

tools.description: Move a file, directory tree to an exact destination.

tools.name: fs_delete
tools.description: Remove a file or directory, requiring explicit recursive deletion.
